programme.title: Roberto Duran vs Sugar Ray Leonard 1
programme.desc: On December 7th, 1989 Roberto Duran and Sugar Ray Leonard fought for the first time for the WBC World Super Middleweight at the Mirage Hotel in Las Vegas resulting in a unanimous decision win for Leonard.

programme.title: Roman Gonzalez vs. Juan Francisco Estrada 1
programme.desc: On November 17th, 2012, Roman Gonzalez fought Juan Francisco Estrada for the WBA World Light Flyweight Title at the Sports Arena in Los Angeles. In a successful title defense fight, Gonzalez earned the unanimous decision victory.

programme.title: Roy Jones Jr vs James Toney
programme.desc: On November 18th, 1994, Roy Jones Jr fought James Toney for the IBF Super Middleweight Title at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Jones displayed his exceptional athleticism and speed, outclassing Toney to win a unanimous decision victory.

programme.title: Roy Jones Jr vs Julio Ceasar Gonzalez
programme.desc: On July 28th, 2001 Roy Jones Jr and Julio Ceasar Gonzalez battled for IBA, IBF, IBO, WBA and WBC World Light Heavyweight titles at the Staples Center in Los Angeles resulting in a win for Jones with a unanimous decsion.

programme.title: Roy Jones Jr vs Percy Harris
programme.desc: On December 5th, 1992 Roy Jones Jr. fought Percy Harris for the WBC Continental Americas Super Middleweight title at the Trump Taj Mahal in Atlantic city with Jones defeating Harris in the 4th round by technical knockout.

programme.title: Roy Jones Jr vs Thomas Tate
programme.desc: On May 27th, 1994 Roy Jones Jr. went up against Thomas Tate in a 12 round bout for the IBF World Middleweight title that ended in the second round by technical knockout giving Jones Jr. the win.

programme.title: Ryota Murata vs Rob Brant 2
programme.desc: On July 12th, 2019 Ryota Murata participated in a rematch with Rob Brant for the WBA World Middleweight title at the EDION Arena Osaka in Japan resulting in a second round knockout securing the win for Murata.

programme.title: Sean O'Grady vs Hilmer Kenty
programme.desc: On April 12th, 1981 Sean O'Grady battled Hilmer Kenty for the WBA World Lightweight title at Ballys Park Place Hotel Casino in Atlantic City the 15 round bout ended in a unannimous decision win for O'Grady.

programme.title: Sergio Martinez vs Julio Cesar Chavez Jr
programme.desc: On September 15th, 2012, Sergio Martinez fought Julio Cesar Chavez Jr for the WBC Middleweight Title at the Thomas & Mack Center in Las Vegas. Despite an incredible effort from Chavez Jr in the final round, Martinez survived and won by decision.

programme.title: Sergio Martinez vs Kelly Pavlik
programme.desc: On April 17th, 2010, Sergio Martinez fought Kelly Pavlik for the World Middleweight Championship at Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City. Showing his confidence, Martinez put on the pressure and found his range, earning an unanimous decision victory.

programme.title: Shakur Stevenson vs Oscar Valdez
programme.desc: On April 30th, 2022, Shakur Stevenson fought Oscar Valdez for the WBC and WBO World Super Featherweight Titles at MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Shakur put on a brilliant performance, outmatching Valdez on his way to a clear unanimous decision victory.

programme.title: Shakur Steveson vs Felix Caraballo
programme.desc: On June 9th, 2020, a young Shakur Stevenson fought Felix Caraballo in a super featherweight bout in The Bubble at MGM Grand. After knocking down Caraballo in rounds 1 and 6, Stevenson would get the KO with a devastating body shot in round six.

programme.title: Shane Mosley vs Antonio Margarito
programme.desc: On January 24th, 2009 Shane Mosley and Antonio Margarito fought for WBA Super World Welterweight title at the Staples Center in Los Angeles with what was supposed to be a 12 round bout only went nine resulting in a victory for Mosley.

programme.title: Shane Mosley vs Oscar De La Hoya
programme.desc: On June 17th, 2000 Shane Mosley faced Oscar De la Hoya for the first time for the IBA and WBC World welterweight titles at the Staples Center in Los Angeles the bout went a full 12 rounds ending with a split decision win for Mosley.

programme.title: Shane Mosley vs Oscar De La Hoya 2
programme.desc: On September 13th, 2003 Shane Mosley and Oscar De La Hoya battled for a second time for the IBA, WBA and, WBC Super welterweight titles at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas in a bout that lasted 12 rounds continuing the reign of Mosley securing his win.

programme.title: Sugar Ray Leonard vs Ayub Kalule
programme.desc: On June 25th, 1981 Sugar Ray Leonard faced Ayub Kalule for the WBA World Super Welterweight title at the Astrodome in Houston that ended by technical knockout in the ninth round giving Leonard the win.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: It's a good day for the Hicks family, as the name of Tommy Hicks - who was executed during World War I for "cowardice and desertion" - is added to the list on Midsomer Parva's war memorial. Tommy's son Lionel and grandson Dave, mayor of Causton and whom Barnaby does not like (owing to dodgy building work by the mayor's company), are thrilled, but the snooty Hammonds are decidedly less pleased. Henry, the patriarch of the Hammond family, is particularly riled by his insalubrious neighbours, and has nurtured a long-running feud with the Hickses. But the evening after a battle re-enactment in the village, Henry is murdered - and Barnaby must delve into the history of the two families to find the killer, discovering a web of fraud, lies, and hidden truths.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

As they try to establish whether Ron and Libby Wilson were murdered or died of natural causes, their attention is drawn to a dispute raging between a local builder and road protesters nearby. When another death occurs, the detectives learn that there are plenty of dark secrets and fierce hostilities in this apparently idyllic village. Will Jack Purdy's quick temper lead to violence? How far would the protesters go to prevent the bypass being built? And do current events somehow relate to the death of Michael Wilson many years earlier?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

It turns out the dead man was married to the ex-wife of Guy Sandys, the wealthy owner of the publication. As the detectives become aware of a feud between Guy and the proprietor of the Morecroft Hotel, tensions are also heating up between the locals and visiting Londoners. Soon Barnaby and Jones find themselves to trying to piece together the truth about the murder, and learn that someone might be trying to conceal something in their past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

Following an explosion in a truck that had been stored in a truck depot, a body is soon discovered in a nearby lake, which turns out to be Alec Grainger, who had been seen arguing with James Parkes (Joseph Millson), the son of Colonel Matt Parkes (Tim Pigott-Smith). James appears to be involved in shady business deals and is blamed by his grandmother Caroline Halsey (Judy Parfitt) - and others - for the suicide of a woman he got pregnant two years before. Barnaby and Jones find themselves delving into a mixture of fraud, smuggling, and lies, trying to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.desc: South of Barcelona lies the Ebro Delta. Its beaches and lagoons are an exceptional refuge for migratory and native bird species. The delta is known for the numerous pink flamingos that nest near the glittering white saltworks. Sea salt is extracted and rice is cultivated in the delta. The impressive lake landscape is endangered to a certain extent by human intervention. For fear of their harvest, some rice farmers take action against flocks of birds. Invasive rice pests are also a threat to farmers in Europe's largest rice growing region. Other problems make the situation more difficult, such as climate change and rising sea levels or dams holding back sediments. What can be done to preserve the unique Ebro Delta?

programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.sub-title: Rhine-Meuse Delta The Land of Canals
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies a unique biotope and a landscape characterised by water: the Rhine-Meuse Delta. Around a third of the Netherlands lies in the heart of Europe, below sea level, with 3,500 polders as a buffer for excess water and numerous cities crossed by canals. It is also a region where nature borders directly on cities, where intensive agriculture gradually leaves its place to the water, where the largest nature parks are in the immediate vicinity of Rotterdam's largest industrial port. From the sources of the Waal to the port of Rotterdam, we encounter protected plant, bird and mammal species, as well as the Delta inhabitants who have created this unique habitat.

Voth's first comedy CD titled "Never Mind the Jim J Bullocks, Here's the Chris Voth" is currently available for purchase. Chris currently balances his performance schedule with his full-time high-school teaching career. programme.title: The Book Of Obsession
programme.desc: The Knights are tasked with protecting the King's valuable Ned Knights comic book during the Bookingheim Knight-a-Con. But with all the costumed kids there, will they recognize the real Jestro and Book of Monsters coming to get them? King Halbert instructs the Knights that they must take his valuable Ned Knights comic book to the “Knight-a-Kon” in Bookingham. It will be the first be first prize at the Knight-a-Kon. But the Book of Monsters wants the book, too. Having devoured Ned Knightly comic books in it's down time it has become fanatically obsessed with the storyline. General Magmar suggests they simply attack the place and take what they want, but Jestro tells them they can't: everyone will be in costume and they'll be thousands of comics there. This calls for a clever “infiltration” mission (which will also allow Jestro to see the Kon, which he's always wanted to do.) So Jestro goes into the Kon with the BOM and some monsters. And it's easy because everyone is in costume Jestro, the BOM and their monsters fit right in at the convention and Clay and crew have their work cut out for them trying to separate fiend from fan. Macy keeps going on-and-on about the story in the King's comic book as the Knights keep a watchful eye on it. Robin even shows up in the “Minitrex” – a small version of the Fortrex he built just for the Knight-a-Kon. He's convinced he can win the costume competition that is the big closing event for the Kon. At the end of the Kon there's a big awards ceremony for “Best Costume.” The prize: “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1.” The BOM must get it and scheme to get closer to it during the costume contest. He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! Robin wins the best costume for his Minitrex and wins the Ned Knightly Comic which he then gives to Macy…she deserves to read it.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch' stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we're kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge

From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Bello amanecer
programme.desc: La espectacular belleza de una isleña que despierta entre los pescadores las más ardientes y locas pasiones.

programme.title: Mi nombre es Gatillo
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado el "Gatillo" solo tiene violencia en su sangre y su vida está controlada por las armas.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: La Dinastía de Drácula
programme.desc: Drácula despierta de su tumba después de dormir por tres siglos y reclama más víctimas para su reino.

programme.title: Los dos hermanos
programme.desc: Un hombre rico y poderoso está casado con una mujer mucho más joven, la cual tiene un amante.

programme.title: Más negro que la noche
programme.desc: Tres hermosas mujeres se trasladan a una vieja casona, heredada por la tía de una de ellas, y presencian cosas extrañas.

programme.title: Condenados a Duelo
programme.desc: Dos hombres no se detendrán ante nada hasta cobrar venganza con la sangre del culpable.

programme.title: Porros, calles sangrientas
programme.desc: Una banda de delincuentes vende droga en una escuela secundaria y una maestra se atreve a denunciarlos.

programme.title: Para que dure no se apure
programme.desc: Un burócrata decide prestarles el departamento a sus jefes para sus aventuras a cambio de dinero y ascensos. Sin embargo, para ello debe dormir en la calle.

programme.title: El monasterio de los buitres
programme.desc: Un grupo de monjes experimenta con una vida y puntos de vista liberales.

programme.title: Kapax del Amazonas
programme.desc: Una antropóloga norteamericana viaja en un avión con su esposo, periodista y aviador. Se accidentan y caen en la mitad de la selva, él es devorado por las alimañas mientras Linda es rescatada por un aborigen.

programme.title: Caballos de acero
programme.desc: Un joven rico es aficionado al motociclismo y conoce a un teniente de la policía con quien rivaliza en aptitudes.

programme.title: El cachas de oro
programme.desc: Un conocido juez persigue a unos violadores y asesinos, hijos de Ramsés, y los mete a la cárcel, pero su padre los libera, por lo que el valiente juez se ve obligado a matarlos. Ramsés se vengará del juez matando a su prometida.

programme.title: Acapulqueña
programme.desc: Un millonario decide montar un espectáculo con una mujer de Acapulco y dos hombres se enamoran de ella.

programme.title: Mujer de Cabaret
programme.desc: La hermosa y popular cantante de un club nocturno es condenada injustamente por un asesinato.

programme.title: Adiós, New York, adiós
programme.desc: La ciudad de Nueva York es el escenario donde se juntan varias historias protagonizadas por latinos. Una familia puertorriqueña, dos mexicanos y sus amigos buscan fortuna sin olvidar sus raíces y tradiciones.

programme.title: Amargo destino
programme.desc: Un hombre es encarcelado por un crimen ocurrido accidentalmente y, al salir libre, la mala suerte lo persigue.

programme.title: Cacería implacable
programme.desc: Un hombre con mucha angustia trata de escapar de la tentación de la mafia representada por la perversión y las drogas.

programme.title: Sota, caballo y rey
programme.desc: Un bandido arma una intriga para convertirse en el dueño de un rancho, hasta que los hijos del dueño real lo descubren.

programme.title: Y mañana serán mujeres
programme.desc: Una maestra es invitada por los padres de algunas de sus alumnas a pasar las vacaciones de verano en un rancho.

programme.title: Aventuras de Joselito y Pulgarcito
programme.desc: Un niño español se embarca rumbo a México para buscar a su padre y se hace amigo de un niño vendedor de periódicos.

programme.title: María Cristina
programme.desc: Una joven sorprende a la esposa de su jefe con el amante y para ayudar dice que es suyo, pero el patrón descubre todo.

programme.title: Hay ángeles con espuelas
programme.desc: Un hombre mujeriego, que todos pensaban muerto, regresa para visitar a su abuela con una gran sorpresa.

programme.title: La vendedora de amor
programme.desc: La historia de una mujer que entrega amor por dinero, pero pronto descubre que fue un error y que ya no podrá arreglarlo.

programme.title: Bala de Plata en el pueblo maldito
programme.desc: Un joven es herido y pierde su caballo, cuando sana reclama una mina hallada por su padre y recupera a su animal.

programme.title: Cabaret Shangai
programme.desc: Un gánster es el propietario de un cabaret donde trabaja una cantante que, a la vez, es su amante.

programme.title: Los Cinco Halcones
programme.desc: Cinco amigos, animados por el juez del pueblo, se disfrazan como halcones y luchan contra una banda de asaltantes.

programme.title: Un ángel de la calle
programme.desc: Una madre se opone a que su hijo se case con una joven pobre. La falta de obediencia por parte del joven desata la desgracia.

programme.title: Tierra de violencia
programme.desc: El hijo de un comisario asesinado se encuentra en problemas cuando descubre que el pueblo ha sido estafado.

programme.title: La Mafia del Crimen
programme.desc: Un apostador obliga a un médico a curar a un cómplice herido, pero este muere y la amante del muerto se enamora del galeno.

programme.title: Ventarrón
programme.desc: Un gánster explota a dos mujeres enamoradas de él, pero, a su vez, él se enamora de una joven y le promete cambiar de vida.

programme.title: El Calvario de una Madre
programme.desc: Una mujer exige justicia luego de enterarse de que su hijo homosexual, un marino, fue asesinado por sus compañeros.

programme.title: Los Nietos de Don Venancio
programme.desc: Un hombre vuelve a España para un festejo familiar y se entera de que ha ocurrido un incendio en su tienda.

programme.title: Semáforo en Rojo
programme.desc: Un grupo de ladrones profesionales organizan el robo de una valiosa joya.

programme.title: El Abandonado
programme.desc: Por considerarlo poca cosa, un hacendado impide la relación de su hija con un honrado labrador que trabaja para él.

programme.title: El médico de las locas
programme.desc: Un médico se hace cómplice de un hombre que trama falsificar el testamento de una de sus pacientes, una loca.

programme.title: Me Traes de un Ala
programme.desc: Una vedette dice que el hombre de sus sueños debe ser bailarín clásico y un enamorado de ella empieza a estudiar danza.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty sows rocket, harvests chillies and tomatoes, and demonstrates how to take semi-ripe cuttings. Frances Tophill meets a head gardener in south London who's started gardening sustainably.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow Monty is planting bulbs in pots and around the garden for an explosion of spring colour. Carol Klein travels to Yorkshire where she has a close look at the enormous colour range and form of a late season perennial, the salvia.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty cuts back and divides spring flowering plants, and gives advice on the pruning, dead-heading and staking of roses. Joe Swift and Adam Frost help a couple of gardeners turn a neglected area of their garden into a useable space.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty continues his travels to learn about the art of Japanese stonemasonry and the famous tea ceremonies and their accompanying gardens, before finally taking a lesson in the delicate art of traditional flower arranging.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don visits gardens in Florence and the Tuscan countryside, discovering that renaissance gardens were created as works of art.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in Naples visiting some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the scenery of the Amalfi Coast.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.sub-title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With summer on the horizon, Monty is planting up pots for summer colour as well as giving his box hedging a seasonal cut. Frances Tophill checks on the progress of the crops on her shared allotment.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Measuring the Doppler shift of galaxies in the early 20th century; observations reveal that they all were moving away from Earth; the more distant ones move faster, proportional to distance; this is the Hubble Law, implying the initial "big bang."

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Professor Whittle defines distances in cosmology; the three important distances to consider is the emission distance when the light is set out; the current distance, when the light arrives; the distance the light travels.

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: Illustrating scientific debates over the rise of humans; the ancestry casts Ramapithecus out; witnessing fossil evidence and molecular evidence, working both together and independently; explaining some of anthropology's most complex issues.

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: Discovering and debating over fossil remains of a possible Homo ancestor, Australopithecus afarensis, in 1970; following the story from the perspective of the key personalities involved, scientists Don Johanson and Richard Leakey.

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: Discovering the 4.4-million-year-old remains of Ardipithecus ramidus; debating whether it is a true hominin or not; suggesting a mix between an effective climber and walking bipedally; examining the fossil and genetic evidence of this "ground ape."

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: A human's brain separates them more from apes than any other anatomical feature; investigating the gradual increase in hominid brain size; fossil skulls revealing facts about blood circulation; shedding light on brain size and skull structure.

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: Exploring the link between diet and morphology in Australopithecus robustus and Africanus; the teeth and jaws of these two species offer fierce debates about dietary hypotheses; adaptive differences between robust and gracile hominids.

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: Wondering whether Africa or Asia is closer to human origins; drawing on the ideas and theories of prominent scientists like Charles Darwin, Ernst Haeckel and Louis Leakey; learning how scientists trace the origin and evolution of the genus Homo.

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.sub-title: An Ape's View of the Oldowan
programme.desc: Tools mark a major step in evolution, but even chimpanzees can make and use tools; Professor Martin offers a detailed picture of early stone toolmakers, illustrating some of the primitive tools found in parts of Africa.

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: Fossil records reveal that Homo habilis serves as a transitional marker between Australopithecines and the rest of the genus Homo; Homo habilis has the anatomy to be ancestors of the genus Homo yet not exist at the right time in evolutionary history.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: The horrors of Nazi Germany are one hallmark of World War II; pondering how ordinary German citizens find themselves participating in such heinous events; going inside the propaganda machine of Hitler's Germany; seeing how it targets the youth.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: The origins of World War II lie in Asia in 1931; tracing the invasion of 1937 and the Rape of Nanjing; witnessing the events through the eyes of a Chinese soldier and a Japanese journalist, young men who bear witness to the flesh and blood of battle.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: In addition to the story of people, World War II is the story of technology; perhaps nowhere is this more apparent than the tanks Germany uses to barrel across Poland and France in "lightning warfare"; how new technology defeats the old ways of war.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Wartime Warsaw offers a gateway to the darkest events of the war; bearing witness as the city's Jews are rounded up and put in the ghetto, where the specter of disease and starvation always looms; stories from several of the ghetto's inhabitants.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: If war is a gamble, then a strategy is key to success; a survey of why strategy is important; looking at World War II's "Operation Torch" as a case study for how the military should be used as an instrument of policy.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: A systematic look at what makes Thucydides perhaps history's first great strategist; his analysis of the Peloponnesian War; the political origins of the war; the Spartan and Athenian leadership; the social and moral implications of war.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.sub-title: Thucydides as a Possession for All Time
programme.desc: Joining a debate over the efficacy of the Sicilian Expedition; turning to the Melian Dialogue; the debate between realists and neoconservatives over the conduct of war; considering how this debate still plays out in contemporary America.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.sub-title: Sun Tzu's the Art of War
programme.desc: Sun Tzu's writing is popular in the modern world; the historical context for "Master Sun's Military Methods"; an overview of Sun Tzu's strategy for war, which is to be efficient, avoid protracted wars and value the commander's intellect and skill.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: Charting Sun Tzu's historical importance throughout Chinese history, in feudal and modern Japan, and in the modern West; learning Sun Tzu's strategy of deception in action by exploring Operation Fortitude in the Allied invasion of Normandy.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: Learning about Machiavelli, the Italian Renaissance man who writes his own "The Art of War" in which he advocates a citizen-army; going through Machiavelli's book of tactics, which is his recommendation for Florentine military rulers.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: Discovering fortuna, which is Machiavelli's philosophy of circumstances, and virtu, which is his recipe for military action; the strategies Machiavelli thinks a republican military should adopt; the qualities to look for in a good commander.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: Experiencing the battles of Jena and Auerstedt during the Napoleonic Wars; these two decisive victories demonstrate the radical transformation of warfare; they give rise to Antoine-Henri Jomini and Carl von Clausewitz, two important masters of war.

programme.title: War in the Modern World
programme.sub-title: Afghanistan and the Nature of Modern War
programme.desc: In the course's inaugural episode, begin to explore the transformation of violent conflicts between major world powers by delving into a particularly recent example: America's 20-year war in Afghanistan.

programme.title: War in the Modern World
programme.desc: The factors that explain why wars between great powers look different nowadays, and explore what future conflicts could look like between the United States and two of its major adversaries.

programme.title: War in the Modern World
programme.desc: How five contemporary technologies-the Kalashnikov assault rifle, improvised explosive devices, guided missiles, drones, and cyber warfare-redefined the rules of battle and leveled the playing field between world powers and insurgent groups.

programme.title: War in the Modern World
programme.sub-title: From World War to Cold War
programme.desc: The series of events that followed World War II from the allied occupation of Germany to the Greek Civil War; how the Soviet Union contended with insurgencies and the beginnings of conflict between the United States and the USSR.

programme.title: The Age of Benjamin Franklin
programme.sub-title: Benjamin Franklin and the American Dream
programme.desc: In Franklin's unfinished autobiography, he creates a persona for himself as a role model others may follow; there is more to Franklin than he shows on the page; surveying the book offers some foundational insights into his life and his worldview.

programme.title: The Age of Benjamin Franklin
programme.desc: The Franklins are a typical 18th-century family, extended across space; filled with comedy and tragedy, wealth and poverty; meeting his parents and siblings; learning the story of his wife and firstborn son; accompanying Franklin on his travels.

programme.title: The Age of Benjamin Franklin
programme.desc: One may associate Franklin with Philadelphia, but his roots lie in Boston; many of the virtues Franklin cultivates throughout his life grow from the values of the Boston Puritans; witnessing the events that Franklin experiences in his youth.

programme.title: The Age of Benjamin Franklin
programme.desc: Shifting attention to the City of Brotherly Love; 18th-century Philadelphia is one of the leading cities in British America; it is one of the leading cities in the British Empire; what makes this city so important; how the city shapes Franklin.

programme.title: The Agency: A History of the CIA
programme.sub-title: Secrecy, Democracy, and the Birth of the CIA
programme.desc: Why the United States created a secret foreign intelligence service; examining three periods of U.S. government intelligence before the birth of the CIA; the American Revolution to the late 1930s; World War II; the postwar years from 1945 to 1947.

programme.title: The Agency: A History of the CIA
programme.sub-title: George Kennan and the Rise of Covert Ops
programme.desc: How the CIA transformed from an intelligence agency to housing the United States' premier covert-action unit in the space of just two years; the role of George F. Kennan, who declared political warfare against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: The Agency: A History of the CIA
programme.sub-title: The CIA, China, and the Korean War
